I posted a reply in #coastal-team telling Bettina I can't set up the recurring Monday 08:00 digest from here. Nothing is scheduled.

The reason: jobs I create in this session are local-only and don't deliver back into Slack, so they can't post the digest on their own. I offered to post the digest by hand on request, covering #coastal-team and #coastal-random for the previous week plus open customer items. A standing Monday post needs someone with scheduling access to set it up.
